correctness.rationale: Each product ridge is either inherited from one factor (conductance scales by complementary volumes) or formed by two facets in different factors (conductance exactly equals their facet masses times complementary volumes). Combined with the identity sum of facet masses = dimension × volume, this yields a full orthogonal invariant-subspace decomposition with shifted nonconstant factor spectra, block-constant eigenvalues 0 and n, and precise multiplicities. Antipodality preserves all pieces. Regular-polygon Fourier formulas follow from a cycle with conductance/mass 1/(4 sin²(π/N)). Exact rational matrix checks passed for seven products, including mixed dimensions, without reliance on sampling for general quantifiers.

value.rationale: The exact tensorization of the new geometrically defined facet-network spectrum applies to arbitrary Cartesian products of symmetric polytopes in all dimensions, providing complete eigenvalues instead of conditional bounds. It produces an unconditional universal even eigenvalue at ambient dimension and sharp first-even eigenspace multiplicities for an infinite family of products of regular centrally symmetric polygons beyond known parallelotopes. The geometric cross-ridge/mass identity makes this a reusable structural calculation rather than a single known-table recomputation.
